{{Quote|The last Human who tried to fly one of our ships crashed into the N'rakti Lava Fields. Your pilots would fall out of the sky like damp moths.|[[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], to Count Dooku|<ref name="NEGVV" />}}
The '''''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighter''', also known as the '''beak-wing fighter''' or simply the '''Geonosian starfighter''', was a model of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was manufactured by [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective/Legends|Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]] and designed for the exclusive use of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] when guarding [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] against intruders. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], these small, speedy craft would see service with the [[Navy/Legends|naval]] and [[Army/Legends|land]] forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in a small number of key battles, including the [[Hunt for the Decimator|campaigns]] of [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] and the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], as well as the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] itself that saw the opening shots of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict.

==Characteristics==
===Design and construction===
[[File:Geonosian_Fighter.jpg|thumb|left|A ''Nantex''-class starfighter docked on its maintenance arm.]]
The ''Nantex''-class starfighter was a lean, needle-nosed [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] craft that possessed great speed and a high degree of agility and was specifically designed for use by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who were drawn from a specific pilot caste within their society. Designed and built by [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective/Legends|Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]], the starfighter's frame was, like many other types of Geonosian [[Starship/Legends|starship]], made from thin strands of pliable [[Laminasteel/Legends|laminasteel]], a long metallic substance that was also used in constructing [[Geonosian hive/Legends|Geonosian hives]]. During the construction process, this material was heated, then wrapped around the assembled inner components of the fighter. When the laminasteel hardened, it produced a strong and flexible aerodynamic frame that could hold itself well against heavy impacts. Once the frame was complete, engineers would fit the craft with magnetic hardpoints to which were mounted the primary engines and weapon. These mounts were completely modular, which allowed for the addition of various other components that may be required to fulfill special missions; these consisted of advanced [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suites, booster rockets, or other additions. The primary engine orb was in a rotary socket, and in the center of this was an ignition chamber. High energy propellant particles were sent into the chamber and through a bottle field. The bottle field only allowed the highest velocity particles through the engine, leading to the ship's great speed.<ref name="NEGVV" />

===Avionics===
The ''Nantex''-class fighter possessed a complex set of multi-axis control yokes that required a Geonosian's considerable manual dexterity in order to properly handle. In addition to this, vital performance feedback and systems information were forwarded to the pilot via a scent-stimulator mask that took advantage of the Geonosians' acute sense of smell; this mask could also be used to fly the craft remotely. These design features made it all but impossible for members of other species to even fly the craft, let alone use it in a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] situation. A single Geonosian pilot sat within a small cockpit, his head protruding up from the main frame into a transparent bubble canopy, which allowed for an unobstructed 360-degree field of vision.

These pilots, raised in vast hives within their caste, were trained to hurl themselves at any enemy force with seemingly reckless abandon; from birth, each pilot was melded with the systems of a specific beak-wing, ensuring a lasting counterpart-level relationship between the two. This allowed for vastly improved reaction time when in combat.<ref name="NEGVV" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
[[File:GeonosianStarfighter-FF70.png|thumb|right|300px|Rear three-quarters, top, forward and aft views of a ''Nantex''-class fighter.]]
The fighter's main weapon was a turret-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] that was cradled between its forward needle-like mandibles and seated within a magnetic bracket. This turret shot amethyst [[Laser/Legends|laser]] bolts, and its emplacement was modular, allowing for other weapons, such as an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]], to be switched in and out as circumstances dictated.<ref name="NEGVV" />

In addition to the modular weapon assembly, the ''Nantex''-class fighter was also lined with one hundred small, independently-aimed [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] and [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] generators. These extra systems could be used to give the starfighter increased maneuverability while flying within an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], limit the mobility of enemy craft, or allow the laser bolts fired from the fighter's main weapon to be guided and fired off-axis. The ''Nantex''-class ship was thought of as a "stealth" vehicle, since its engine and weapons systems emitted very little ambient glow for sensors to pick up. This was used to the Geonosians' advantage when defending their home territory: whenever an intruding force threatened their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], hordes of these craft would swarm out of the Geonosian [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]], ambushing any would-be attackers.<ref name="NEGVV" />

==History==
===Pre&ndash;Clone Wars roles===
Prior to the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Geonosians relied on the beak-wing starfighter as one of their primary defenses against unwelcome outsiders.<ref name="NEGVV" /> The world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] was surrounded by a ring of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that, while relatively stable, was made of many hundreds of thousands of individual rocks that ranged from the size of small pebbles to large bulk [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]],<ref name="epII">{{Film|II}}</ref> all of which served as superior positions from which to stage ambush raids. With their inherent maneuverability and the skill of their bonded pilots, ''Nantex''-class fighters were able to negotiate the field in ways that other vessels could not.<ref name="NEGVV" />

===Battles during the Clone Wars===
[[File:Nantex-class_fighters.png|thumb|left|250px|''Nantex''-class fighters fought in the First Battle of Geonosis.]]
Many ''Nantex''-class fighters were used during the opening stages of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. A number of these craft, accompanied by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]], were sent to intercept the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] [[Aken (Acclamator-class)|''Aken'']], which was carrying thousands of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who were accompanying the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] mission to rescue those [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fighting in the [[Petranaki arena]] in the wake of their attempt to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="SWJS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref> As the battle wound down, a pair of these craft protected [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] from the pursuing [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] carrying Obi-Wan and Anakin, as he fled to his personal [[Dooku's hangar/Legends|hangar]] ahead of the impending [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] rout.<ref name="epII" /> As the target of assassination by [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], the Geonosian [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Sun Fac/Legends|Sun Fac]] attempted to flee his homeworld aboard a ''Nantex'' fighter, but he was shot down by the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] before he could get away.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>

A large number of ''Nantex''-class fighters served with the Confederacy forces that participated in [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann's]] [[Hunt for the Decimator|campaign]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], in which she was sent by her mentor, Count Dooku, to disrupt a secret project and acquire its results, the [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]]. On the worlds of [[Eredenn Prime]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], [[Sarapin/Legends|Sarapin]], [[Aereen]], and [[Krant]], these craft would serve as air support for ground troops as well as a buffer force against the Republic's LAAT/is and Jedi-flown [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 interceptors]]. The campaign saw initial success for the Confederacy, but with the leadership of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]], the clone forces would ultimately triumph. This resulted in the death of Tann and the destruction of most of her forces.<ref name="SWGBCC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>

[[File:SpaceDuck.jpg|thumb|right|225px|''Nantex''-class fighters chasing [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] ''[[Azure Angel]]'' during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]].]]
Though the Geonosians did not sell these fighters to outsiders, they were seen being piloted by [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]-owned and operated [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|OOM pilot battle droids]] during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle]] of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] in which swarms of them, deployed from [[InterGalactic Banking Clan gun platform/Legends|orbital gun platforms]], faced off against the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone-piloted]] [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] utilized by the Galactic Republic during the battle.<ref name="CWch2">{{CW|2}}</ref>

''Nantex''-class starfighters were used to defend the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|primary droid foundry]] against the attacking Republic forces during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Landing">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>

[[19 BBY/Legends|Late in the Clone Wars]], ''Nantex''-class fighters were part of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] task force during the General's [[Battle of Belderone|attack on]] [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]]. It also served as the basis for the [[Commerce Guild fleet patrol craft]].<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

By [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], a ''Nantex''-class fighter had been abandoned on the scrapyard world of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:NTDS.png|thumb|left|250px|Side-view of the beak-wing fighter.]]
The ''Nantex''-class starfighter was first created for use in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], but it was first seen in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]'', which takes place just before and during the film. Within the game, these craft also mounted warhead launchers in addition to their laser cannons.<ref name="SWJS" />

Initially, the droid starfighter seen in Episode I was to be the primary air defense for the Separatists, but it was decided instead to give the Geonosians their own fighter craft. At one point, it was imagined that the fighter would be equipped with large sails, but that concept was instead folded into Count Dooku's solar sailer. When the air battle was cut, the fighter was instead slated to appear in a shot wherein a Republic attack gunship strafes a Geonosian airstrip, destroying the waiting craft. That shot was ultimately omitted.<ref name="DB-Geonosian starfighter">{{DB|starship|geonosianfighter|Geonosian starfighter}}</ref>

In the video game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'', the Nantex is presented as the "Fast Geonosian Fighter," preceded by the "Geonosian Fighter" and succeeded by the "Advanced Geonosian Fighter" in the in-game tech tree for the Confederacy forces.<ref name="SWGBCC" />

The beak-wing, as featured in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', is flyable by any class of in-game character; this is likely gameplay mechanics.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref>

Although they are seen in ''Attack of the Clones'' and ''Jedi Starfighter'' flying upright, the Clone Wars series has depicted them as spinning constantly during flight rather than flying straight.
